meta.title: AiSystem — Shared AI resource library and synchronization

seo.title: AiSystem — shared AI resource library
seo.description: A macOS app to centralize, inspect and distribute shared AI skills and reference documents across projects and development assistants.

hero.hook: One source of truth for AI development resources
hero.description: A native macOS app that brings skills and documents together, highlights differences across projects, and controls distribution to Claude and Codex.

visual.alt: Illustrated preview of AiSystem: overview and resource synchronization for Claude and Codex.

overview.problem: When projects maintain separate rules and AI skills, copies drift and changes become difficult to track across Claude and Codex.
overview.solution: AiSystem centralizes reference sources, detects differences, and lets users choose, preview, and distribute versions without silently overwriting local edits.
overview.audience: Developers working across projects and AI assistants
overview.scope: SwiftUI desktop app and local Python/Bash automation

workflow.title: Collect shared resources
workflow.description: Bring reference documents and skills into one shared library.

visual.title: Shared reference library
visual.description: Canonical files are organized and linked to their target projects.

workflow.title: Choose target projects
workflow.description: Select which items each project receives without immediately changing its files.

visual.title: Per-project distribution

workflow.title: Compare versions
workflow.description: Spot newer project copies and choose which version to import.

visual.title: Source selection
visual.description: Library and project copies can be compared by date and content.

workflow.title: Preview and distribute
workflow.description: Review creates, replacements and blockers before applying controlled changes.

visual.title: Preview before writing
visual.description: Operations expose their effects and offer conditional undo.

architecture.description: SwiftUI invokes Bash routes through Process; Python modules use YAML sources to handle checks, versions, and project copies.

nodes.label: CommandRunner
nodes.role: Runs local actions using separate arguments

challenges.title: Spot drift without competing sources
challenges.constraint: The same resources are copied across projects and Claude/Codex formats.
challenges.solution: A registry and manifest define canonical sources; Inventory and Doctor classify missing, drifting, or conflicting copies.

challenges.title: Prevent accidental overwrites during distribution
challenges.constraint: Synchronization can meet local edits or an outdated operation plan.
challenges.solution: Preview, plan IDs, explicit blockers, per-project atomic writes, and conditional undo.

challenges.title: Keep business state separate from process logs
challenges.constraint: The app needs clear operation feedback while business actions run as local command-line processes.
challenges.solution: Versioned JSON contracts, Swift decoding, cached reads, and a session-scoped operation history.

outcomes.title: Native macOS control interface
outcomes.description: Overview, Projects, Library and Activity destinations, a command palette, and contextual operation feedback.

outcomes.title: Reusable resource library
outcomes.description: Shared resource management, version selection, project targeting, imports and redistribution.

outcomes.title: Checks and recovery workflows
outcomes.description: Inventory, diagnostics, change previews, guarded writes, and conditional undo support.
